what: Underrated PS2 games for the Underrated page, in the order they are shown: one is revealed per day from `launch` (the first is the game of that day), and none is shown before its day. Made by hand. 40 titles ('via': 'lists') were collected from the articles under `lists`; 60 more ('via': 'own') are picks from general knowledge, not from those lists. The one-line reasons are written here, never quoted. Famous classics are left out (see `never`). No scores or ranks are kept. `developer` is the studio that made the game, written from general knowledge and left null where unsure.

dog.name: Den of Geek: 50 Underrated PlayStation 2 Games

tg.name: TheGamer: 20 PS2 Games That Are Criminally Underrated

spc.name: Super Phillip Central: Most Overlooked PlayStation 2 Games

games.title: Rygar: The Legendary Adventure
games.why: Tecmo's 3D revival of the arcade hero, built on a chained shield weapon you swing and combo like a whip.

games.title: Castlevania: Curse of Darkness
games.why: A 3D Castlevania with a monster-raising system and one of the series' better combat engines.

games.title: Wild Arms 5
games.why: The long-running Western-flavoured RPG series on PS2, with a re-tooled battle system.

games.title: Darkwatch
games.why: A vampire western shooter with a bad-or-good gunslinger arc and a horse.

games.title: Space Channel 5: Part 2
games.why: Ulala is back with more dancing, bigger boss fights and a cheerful sci-fi mood.

games.title: Shinobi
games.why: A fast, demanding ninja action game with a sword that grows on every kill.

games.title: Viewtiful Joe 2
games.why: Capcom's slow-motion superhero brawler, playable as two heroes this time.

games.title: Radiata Stories
games.why: A cheerful, offbeat RPG with over a hundred recruitable characters who each live a daily routine.

games.title: Mega Man X8
games.why: The last proper X game, with a tag-team pair of heroes and a shiny 2.5D look.

games.title: Oni
games.why: Bungie's third-person martial arts shooter, with anime-style melee and a cyberpunk setting.

games.title: Haunting Ground
games.why: You run and hide as a young woman with a dog partner, in a castle full of people who want her.

games.title: Chaos Legion
games.why: Capcom's fast action game where the hero fights alongside summoned legions.

games.title: Seven Samurai 20XX
games.why: A sci-fi retelling of Seven Samurai as an action game, with a stylised look.

games.title: Red Faction II
games.why: A quick, loud shooter with a bold approach to blowing up walls.

games.title: Project Eden
games.why: Four-character squad action: swap between four members of a futuristic police team to solve puzzles.

games.title: Everblue 2
games.why: A calm diving game in which you explore wrecks and photograph the marine life.

games.title: Obscure
games.why: Teen survival horror in a school at night, played in pairs and with flashlights that hurt the monsters.

games.title: R.A.D.: Robot Alchemic Drive
games.why: Giant-robot battles through a city, with the robots controlled by two sticks like levers.

games.title: Silent Hill 4: The Room
games.why: The odd one in the series: a locked apartment you keep coming back to as a safe, then unsafe, base.

games.title: Mark of Kri
games.why: A brutal combat system you aim with the right stick, and a barbarian with a bird that scouts.

games.title: Second Sight
games.why: Psychic powers and a story told across two time periods, from the makers of TimeSplitters.

games.title: Auto Modellista
games.why: A racer drawn like a comic book, with a look nothing else on the console shared.

games.title: Steambot Chronicles
games.why: A steam-powered open-world RPG where you pilot a robot that doubles as a musical instrument.

games.title: Amplitude
games.why: The follow-up to Frequency, with licensed songs and a smoother look.

games.title: Mad Maestro!
games.why: A conducting game where you wave the orchestra through classical pieces.

games.title: Blood Will Tell
games.why: A hack-and-slash adaptation of Osamu Tezuka's Dororo, with a hero who rebuilds his body.

games.title: Arc the Lad: Twilight of the Spirits
games.why: A tactical RPG about two heroes on opposite sides of the same conflict.

games.title: Maximo: Ghosts to Glory
games.why: A tough, good-looking descendant of Ghosts 'n Goblins, with armour that breaks as you take hits.

games.title: Shadow Hearts: Covenant
games.why: The sequel moves to Europe around the First World War and keeps the strange tone and the timing-ring combat.

games.title: Klonoa 2: Lunatea's Veil
games.why: A gentle, inventive 2.5D platformer with a story that turns out to be about more than it seems.

games.title: Kessen
games.why: Koei's battle strategy game, set in Japan's feudal wars and shown as a cinematic.

games.title: Suikoden III
games.why: One story told from three points of view, with a hundred-plus recruitable characters in the usual Suikoden fashion.

games.title: Atelier Iris: Eternal Mana
games.why: A gentle craft-and-fight RPG where collecting and combining materials is half the game.

games.title: XIII
games.why: A comic-book shooter that draws every explosion in thick ink, with a conspiracy plot to match.

games.title: Musashi: Samurai Legend
games.why: Square Enix action RPG with a free-roaming sword-and-sidekick structure and a bright, storybook look.

games.title: Wipeout Fusion
games.why: A darker and heavier take on the futuristic racer, with a good soundtrack and tough ships.

games.title: Fantavision
games.why: A fireworks puzzle game that was among the first games on the console, and still looks good.

games.title: Tales of Legendia
games.why: A Tales game with a strong focus on its chapter-by-chapter characters.

games.title: Summoner
games.why: An early PS2 RPG with a big summoning system and a real-time combat party.

games.title: SOS: The Final Escape
games.why: Survive a city-wide earthquake on foot: a disaster adventure with no enemies, only the buildings.

games.title: Magic Pengel: The Quest for Color
games.why: Draw your own monsters with a paintbrush and watch them fight.

games.title: Cold Winter
games.why: A Cold War spy shooter that was ambitious for its time and then quickly forgotten.

games.title: Rule of Rose
games.why: A disquieting story of an orphanage and a group of children, built on a girl and her dog.

games.title: La Pucelle: Tactics
games.why: Nippon Ichi's early tactics game about a young priestess cleansing demon worlds.

games.title: Forbidden Siren
games.why: A horror game where you play through a cursed village from many points of view, seeing through enemy eyes.

games.title: Tak and the Power of Juju
games.why: A friendly cartoon platformer built around a young shaman and his magical masks.

games.title: Frequency
games.why: Harmonix's first music game: hit notes on a spinning tunnel of tracks, remixing as you go.

games.title: Giants: Citizen Kabuto
games.why: Three-way war between pirates, magic-using sea elves and one giant, played from three viewpoints.

games.title: Phantom Brave
games.why: A tactics RPG where your units are summoned ghosts bound to the objects on the battlefield.

games.title: Gungrave
games.why: Wall-to-wall shooting with a coffin-wielding gunman, styled by the artist behind Trigun.

games.title: Stuntman
games.why: You are the film-set driver: reach each stunt in one take while the director calls cues.

games.title: Tenchu: Wrath of Heaven
games.why: The ninja-stealth series at its sharpest: rooftops, silent kills and a tense, patient pace.

games.title: Deus Ex
games.why: The PC classic of choices and conspiracies, squeezed onto PS2 with its freedom intact.

games.title: Valkyrie Profile 2: Silmeria
games.why: Dark Norse-myth RPG from tri-Ace, with a fast and flashy real-time battle system.

games.title: Shadow of Destiny
games.why: A murder mystery where you keep travelling back in time to stop your own death.

games.title: Grandia III
games.why: A fast, colourful RPG whose battle system rewards timing and positioning.

games.title: Urban Chaos: Riot Response
games.why: Rocksteady's pre-Batman shooter: you play a firefighter-cop in a riot-torn city.

games.title: Shadow of Rome
games.why: Capcom's gladiator action game, switching between hack-and-slash arenas and stealth missions.

games.title: Okage: Shadow King
games.why: A dry, funny RPG in which a teenage girl's family is stuck with a self-important demon lord.

games.title: Shadow Hearts
games.why: A horror-flavoured RPG set in the early 1900s, where a timing ring decides how well your attacks land.

games.title: Rogue Galaxy
games.why: Level-5's big space adventure, with real-time fights and a crew of planet-hopping misfits.

games.title: Ghosthunter
games.why: A ghost-hunting action adventure with a nicely spooky, bright look.

games.title: Cold Fear
games.why: Survival horror on a storm-tossed ship, with waves that move the floor under your feet.

games.title: Project: Snowblind
games.why: A near-future shooter from Crystal Dynamics with gadgets, augmentations and a mid-battle choice of approach.

games.title: Legaia 2: Duel Saga
games.why: A combo-driven RPG where you chain button inputs to build your attacks.

games.title: Headhunter
games.why: A motorbike-and-stealth action game about a bounty hunter in a near-future city.

games.title: Extermination
games.why: Sci-fi survival horror in an Antarctic base, with a thing-in-the-ice mood and a lot of shooting.

games.title: Mystic Heroes
games.why: A cartoony, accessible spin on the Dynasty Warriors formula, with a magic system.

games.title: Breath of Fire: Dragon Quarter
games.why: A dark, survival-style Breath of Fire where your hero's health can run out.

games.title: Primal
games.why: Two worlds, two heroines: a gothic action adventure with a shapeshifting demon companion.

games.title: Bujingai
games.why: A stylish sword-and-gun action game with a monk who fights in a leather jacket.

games.title: Evil Dead: A Fistful of Boomstick
games.why: Ash Williams shooting and chopping through the dead, with the film's wisecracks.

games.title: Freedom Fighters
games.why: Squad shooter in a Soviet-occupied New York, from the makers of Hitman.

games.title: Suikoden IV
games.why: A seafaring Suikoden with ship travel and a smaller, quieter tale than its predecessors.

games.title: Fahrenheit
games.why: A murder mystery you play from both sides, the detective's and the killer's. Released in the US as Indigo Prophecy.

games.title: Drakan: The Ancients' Gates
games.why: Fantasy action in which you fight on foot and from a dragon's back.

games.title: Eternal Ring
games.why: FromSoftware's launch-day first-person RPG, set in a stark fantasy world with ring-based magic.

games.title: The Suffering
games.why: Horror shooter set in a haunted prison: you also choose how brutal your character becomes.

games.title: Psychonauts
games.why: A summer camp where children train psychic powers, and every level is inside somebody's mind.

games.title: Gungrave: Overdose
games.why: The sequel to Gungrave, with more characters and the same non-stop shooting.

games.title: Gregory Horror Show
games.why: A hotel of ghosts run as a puppet show, based on a Japanese TV series, with a cardboard-cutout look.

games.title: Ape Escape 3
games.why: The monkey-catching series at its most polished, with a new look and a lot of gadgets.

games.title: Gitaroo Man
games.why: A rhythm game as a surreal boss-fight story, with a hero who plays a guitar.

games.title: Wild Arms 3
games.why: A Western-flavoured RPG with a cel-shaded look and four wandering heroes.

games.title: Ring of Red
games.why: An alternate-history tactics game where Japan was split after the war and mechs fight on the ground.

games.title: Gradius V
games.why: Treasure's take on the classic shooter, with tight patterns and big bosses.

games.title: Jade Cocoon 2
games.why: Catch, merge and raise monsters in a small, pretty RPG about a young boy and a spirit world.

games.title: Echo Night: Beyond
games.why: A slow, eerie ghost-story adventure where you help the dead rather than fight them.

games.title: Clock Tower 3
games.why: Hide-and-seek horror with no real weapons: you outrun your pursuers and use the environment.

games.title: Maximo vs. Army of Zin
games.why: More of the same ghoul-smashing platforming, with a bigger and kinder structure.

games.title: Zone of the Enders: The 2nd Runner
games.why: A fast mech brawler from Konami, built around speed and a lot of lock-on action.

games.title: Kill Switch
games.why: A cover-based third-person shooter that arrived before the style became common.

games.title: Total Overdose
games.why: A loud, Mexican-set shooter with trick moves, slow motion and a hero who loves a show.

games.title: LifeLine: Voice Action Adventure
games.why: You guide a survivor through a space station by speaking into a USB headset.

games.title: Mister Mosquito
games.why: You are a mosquito: bite a family, avoid the swatter, drain just enough blood. Odd and charming.

games.title: Dirge of Cerberus: Final Fantasy VII
games.why: Vincent Valentine in a third-person shooter set after Final Fantasy VII, with RPG levelling bolted on.

games.title: Rumble Racing
games.why: Arcade racing with trick jumps and power-ups, built around bouncy muscle cars.

games.title: Contra: Shattered Soldier
games.why: Short, hard and exact: a return to the series' run-and-gun roots.

games.title: Psi-Ops: The Mindgate Conspiracy
games.why: Telekinesis, mind control and exploding things with your mind, in an engine built for throwing everything.

games.title: The Thing
games.why: A sequel to the John Carpenter film where you must decide which of your squad you trust.
